title: Curry-Spiced Haloumi & Cauliflower Bowl
subtitle: with Garlic Rice & Zingy Cucumber
description: Who said meat-free dishes can't be satisfying and salivating? Enjoy roasted, curry-spiced veggies and haloumi teamed with rice and a zesty garlic yoghurt for a bountiful bowlful of texture and flavour.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan-forced. Chop cauliflower (including stalk!) into small florets.
• Roughly chop carrot into bite-sized chunks. Slice red onion into wedges.
• In a medium bowl, place haloumi and cover with water to soak.
• Place cauliflower, carrot and onion on a lined oven tray. Sprinkle with curry spice blend. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt. Toss to coat.
• Roast until tender, 20-25 mins.

• Finely chop or crush garlic. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter with a dash of olive oil over medium heat.
• Cook 1/2 the garlic until fragrant, 1-2 mins. Add basmati rice, the water and a generous pinch of salt and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low and cover with a lid. Cook for 10 mins, then remove from heat and keep covered until rice is tender and the water is absorbed, 10 mins.

• Finely chop cucumber. Zest lemon to get a pinch and slice into wedges.
• In a medium bowl, combine cucumber with a drizzle of olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice. Season to taste.
• In a small heatproof bowl, combine the remaining garlic and a drizzle of olive oil. Microwave in 10 second bursts, until fragrant, 1 min.
• Add Greek-style yoghurt, lemon zest and a generous squeeze of lemon juice to garlic oil, stirring to combine. Season to taste.
• Drain haloumi and pat dry. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook haloumi until golden brown, 1-2 mins each side.
Divide garlic rice between bowls. Top with curry-spiced cauliflower, haloumi and zingy cucumber. Dollop over lemon-garlic yoghurt. Serve with any remaining lemon wedges.
